verdicts.item:
2. After a release without a type, its pointers are still listed by 'list
   artifacts' with their statuses.
   Shows A22-2. [witness: verification:registry_a22_removed_type_pointers_still_listed]

quotes: assert [p for p in after if p["artifact_type"] == "estimate"] == listed_a
verdicts.why: After restarting on a release that removes the type, the check requires all previously captured pointers and statuses to remain identical in both listing APIs and the projection, and requires the stored rows to remain unchanged. It also verifies that adding a pointer of the new type does not alter the removed type's listed history.
